sentences.en: Global warming will change the patterns of the weather world-wide.
sentences.zh: 全球变暖会改变全世界天气模式。

sentences.en: Global warming can cause serious problems for wild animals, too.
sentences.zh: 全球变暖也会对野生动物造成严重问题。

sentences.en: As global warming increases, sea levels get higher and higher.
sentences.zh: 随着全球变暖加剧，海平面越来越高。
